name: bazaria
description: Bazaria multi-tenant sales and distribution management platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bazaria/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bazaria/shared && npm run build -w @bazaria/api && npm run build -w @bazaria/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bazaria/shared && npm run test -w @bazaria/api && npm run test -w @bazaria/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @bazaria/shared && npm run test -w @bazaria/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w @bazaria/shared && npm run test -w @bazaria/web
